intent.statement: Proposed from the user's goal: show what is blocked on the user right now and the one action that unblocks it; keep metrics and history secondary.

primary.content: Decision card: Codex stopped on T016 at its weekly limit, with the proposed next agent and the handoff facts summary
primary.reason: Work on the project is stopped until the user chooses; a total or chart does not change any decision on this screen.
primary.action: Hand over T016 to Claude Sonnet 5.5

secondary: Other items waiting for the user (approval of stage 3 toolkit, review ready)
Tasks running now with agent, model and state
Limit risk per account (only remaining share and reset time)

controls.family: Pill segmented control and buttons share 44px height (primary 46px), full radius for pills, 10px for buttons.
controls.search: No search on Today; search lives in History.
controls.filter_scope: Segmented scope 'Ждут вас / Идут / Все' filters only the item list below it; the decision card always shows the top blocking item.
controls.result_count: Each scope pill shows a count derived from the same item array it filters.
controls.selection: Opening an item navigates to its task screen with the same task id in the title; back returns to Today with the same scope.

chart.reason: No chart changes a decision on Today; limits are shown as remaining share with reset time.

mobile.first_useful_object: Decision card for T016 with the primary 46px hand-over button inside the first fold
